stem: The number ${=n}$ is added to each of the two terms of the ratio ${=a} : {=b}$. Find the sum of the two terms of the new ratio.
solution: The new ratio is ${=p} : {=q}$. (Adding a number to both terms changes the ratio.)
The sum of its two terms is ${=p} + {=q} = {=p + q}$.
notes: Basic entry point: adding the same number to both terms and computing the new ratio's terms. Parent is the book's add-to-both-terms example.
